blurb: Guests participate in themed escape rooms and virtual reality escape games, solving puzzles and challenges to escape within a time limit. The VR games are multiplayer and use free-roaming technology. Private and public bookings are available, with options for corporate events and parties.
extraNote: Arrive at least 10 minutes early · No refunds or rescheduling for late arrival · Private bookings available Mon-Fri daytime · Public sessions available evenings and weekends · Pricing varies by room, day, and private or public booking
